name: ANSI/IEEE Latched pull-cord switch form
aliases: IEEE Pull Cord Switch Latched, Normally Open
summary: IEEE-library form of latched pull-cord switch: this representation distinguishes a pull-cord actuator whose operated state is latched.
description: This reference locates latched pull-cord switch in Autodesk's IEEE-oriented miscellaneous switches family. This representation distinguishes a pull-cord actuator whose operated state is latched. The public library uses HPC11L for its horizontal representation; this is a vendor block name, not an IEEE standards symbol number.
